Subject: RFI: Isolated/on-prem deployment capabilities for Aegis Health

Ben,

Thanks for the intro last week. Procurement and our cloud security team have put together a short RFI covering private deployment requirements for a potential production pilot. High level asks: VPC-only install process, operator model, KMS/HSM integration, patching/upgrade story in air-gapped sites, and evidence we can use for our engineering security review (checksums, SBOM, attestations).

I attached the questionnaire (Aegis_RFI_Questions.pdf). Can you confirm a target date for a written response and whether Redwood can provide an operator-runbook and a sample installation checklist?

Also: who from your team can take technical follow-ups? We'll likely include our infra lead (Mike O'Neil) on the next round.

Priya Singh
Sr. Procurement Manager | Aegis Health
priya.singh@aegishealth.com

[Attachment: Aegis_RFI_Questions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Isolated/on-prem deployment capabilities for Aegis Health

Priya —

Appreciate the RFI. We've reviewed the questionnaire and prepared an initial response pack and a capability matrix that maps Aegis's asks to our product controls. I've attached both: RI_PrivateDeploy_CapabilityMatrix.xlsx and a filled PDF (Aegis_RFI_Responses.pdf).

Quick answers to your top-line items:
- VPC install: Supported via our Private offering. We provide an installer package for customer-controlled VPCs plus a sealed air-gap bundle for disconnected installs.
- Operator model: Customer-operated by default; optional operator-assisted engagement available under a Dedicated support agreement.
- KMS/HSM: We support KMIP-compatible HSMs and cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Google KMS, Azure KeyVault) with customer-owned keys; documentation and keyflow diagrams in the matrix.
- Patch/upgrade: Offline patch bundles with SHA256 checksums + SBOMs; upgrade runbook is included.

Jordan Blake (cc'd) is our technical lead on private deployments — he'll follow up with the deeper technical clarifications and a draft runbook link. Marissa will coordinate procurement/sow items.

Target: We can deliver a detailed RFI response and runbook draft by EOD Sep 10, and a follow-up call the week of Sep 13. Does that align with your timeline?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

[Attachments: RI_PrivateDeploy_CapabilityMatrix.xlsx (xlsx), Aegis_RFI_Responses.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: RFI: Isolated/on-prem deployment capabilities for Aegis Health

Priya / Mike —

Forwarding the initial pack from Ben and adding technical clarifications below. I've also uploaded a draft operator runbook and network diagrams to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aegis-RI-Runbook-Draft

Technical clarifications (summary):
1) KMS/HSM: We sign and seal runtime keys using customer-provided KEKs. For HSMs supporting KMIP, Redwood's private control plane negotiates with on-prem HSM via a customer-configured gateway. We do not persist plaintext model keys on our side.
2) Egress control: The offline/air-gapped installer supports a strict outbound-blocking mode; telemetry is buffered locally and can be exported via signed artifact transfer only.
3) Upgrade path: Air-gapped upgrades use signed bundles with accompanying SBOM and SHA256 checksums. The runbook includes a rollback procedure and operator pre-checks (disk, GPU driver, kernel module versions).
4) Audit evidence: We can provide attestations, SBOMs (CycloneDX), and a signing log. For SOC-2 scope items, we provide evidence artifacts but would recommend a scoped audit addendum to be included in the SOW.

Open items for your infra team: preferred HSM vendor/model for integration, network ACL pattern for control-plane access (if any), and whether your security team requires a FIPS-validated crypto path.

I'll be available for a technical call Sep 14-15; please share a slot.
